criteria.text: CAP-001/CAPG0 PASS
CAP-002/CAPG1 PASS
CAP-003/CAPG2 PASS
CAP-004/CAPG3 PASS
CAP-005/CAPG4 PASS
CAP-006/CAPG5 PASS
every prior protocol lock and amendment chain verifies (CAP-001..006, CAPSTONE_UI_V1, V2-FL system, FEDPROX_MU_V2, FL_INIT_V2)
CAPSTONE_UI_V1 lock verifies and the frontend is byte-identical to the entry commit (Federation pages stay NOT YET ENABLED)
V2-FL-005 evidence, FL_INIT_V2 and the V2 FL / FedProx / SecAgg bound artifacts are unchanged
MODEL_V1/MODEL_V2_FINAL, calibrations, SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2, DEFAULT_RUNTIME_BINDING_V2 and every other named protected component are unchanged
the CAP-006 implementation, the CAP-004 store/auth/persistence, api/product_app_v1_1.py and the CAP-003 monitoring path are byte-identical to the entry commit
the entry commit is recorded, HEAD descends from it and CAP-007 was marked IN_PROGRESS / CAPG6 NOT_STARTED before any implementation
the CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_PROTOCOL_V1 freeze commit precedes every canonical result file and no bound file drifted since the freeze
the contract reconciliation audit was written prospectively and records the exact V1->V2 delta
CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_CONTRACT_V2 is an additive successor: the V1 file is unchanged and the only delta is AGGREGATING -> COMPLETED for non-final rounds
non-final rounds complete after aggregation and only the final round creates a candidate
CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_EXECUTION_BINDING_V1 is frozen with one candidate per run, intermediate aggregates as round states and the lineage rules
CAPSTONE_FL_CLIENT_ADAPTER_V2 is an additive successor of V1 (V1 unchanged) that inherits, not re-implements, the local training path
round 1 starts only from FL_INIT_V2
every round N>1 starts from the digest of the immediately preceding committed round state
MODEL_V2_FINAL and candidates are refused as a federation base
the canonical run base model is FL_INIT_V2
a user cannot submit a model, checkpoint, mu, learning rate, optimizer, batch size, calibration, threshold, base model or candidate id
the create-run request carries exactly the five frozen request fields
only FL_SINGLE_RUN is accepted publicly and planned_rounds must be 3
monitoring scenario ids, FL_NEW_LOCAL_BATCH and FL_MULTIRUN_CANDIDATE_HISTORY are rejected publicly
the canonical LIVE_RUN completes through the real CAPSTONE_PRODUCT_API_V1_2 process with explicit DEMO auth and a temporary SQLite file
the canonical run performs exactly 24 genuine local training calls
the canonical run has 24 accepted and 0 rejected updates
the canonical run has exactly 3 rounds of 8 accepted updates
the canonical run uses exactly the eight SIM_FL_SITE_00..07 clients
the canonical run creates exactly one candidate, CAPSTONE_FL_CANDIDATE_0001, in an empty registry
the candidate parent is FL_INIT_V2
the candidate digest equals the round-3 committed global state
round state paths equal the frozen CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_CONTRACT_V2 paths
every federation event validates against PRODUCT_LIVE_EVENT_V1, the sequence is contiguous and ids are deterministic
training progress events carry only the frozen start (0) and completion (1) milestones
POST start returns promptly while the run executes in the background
two canonical runs in fresh processes are semantically identical
the two canonical runs used different server process ids and both created CAPSTONE_FL_CANDIDATE_0001 in their own empty databases
the two canonical federation event streams are identical after the frozen projection
every subscriber (two live, one late reconnect) received the identical stream
no federation event or SQL row carries raw data, labels, truth or tensors
every submitted envelope passes scan_forbidden with zero findings
the V2-FL-005 global state lineage (FL_INIT, round 1, round 2, round 3) is reproduced exactly
all 24 updates match V2-FL-005: client set, per-round examples_seen
all 24 updates match V2-FL-005 shuffle seeds
all 24 updates match V2-FL-005 update SHAs
per-round base and committed digests match V2-FL-005
the candidate digest equals the V2-FL-005 round-3 state
the V2-FL-005 parity holds in both canonical runs
candidate IDs are allocated atomically and the first candidate in an empty registry is 0001
an existing artifact directory forces the next candidate number
the candidate artifact is serialised, verified, atomically renamed and tampering is detected
candidate weights never enter SQLite and only the five policy tables are used
the released and candidate model namespaces never mix
the candidate state file digest matches its metadata and the registry row
GET /models and GET /models/{id} are authenticated read-only GLOBAL_READ routes
no promote, deploy, set-default or select-model route exists
production_deployed is false and scientific_promotion is false everywhere
only the five frozen structural validation checks exist and all pass for the canonical candidate
each validation check fails for its own defect
acceptance requires every check and yields sandbox-only status
a failed check rejects the candidate and it never reaches the sandbox
the governance state machine is the frozen one and cannot skip validation
the governance decision is persisted with scientific_promotion=false and production_deployed=false
no inference runs on a candidate and no CAPSTONE_FL_SANDBOX_RUNTIME exists
a full temporary FedProx 3-round product run completes with 24 calls and 24 accepted updates
FedProx uses the frozen mu 0.1 and produces one finite candidate
the FedProx run computes no metrics, tunes nothing and deploys nothing
the invalid-update scenario produces STALE_ROUND, DUPLICATE_UPDATE, BASE_STATE_MISMATCH and UNKNOWN_CLIENT through the existing coordinator logic
the invalid-update scenario is separate: normal runs inject nothing and no run, round or candidate is created
the SecAgg shadow verifies round 1 only and aggregation stays PLAIN
the shadow run matched the expectations 8 clients, max_weight 256, 8 plain clear updates, 0 protected clear updates
the frozen SecAgg tolerances are untouched and never widened
a failed shadow fails the run loudly without a candidate
the SecAgg claim scope is PROTECTED_AGGREGATION_INTERFACE_ONLY with no DP or anonymity claim
only the five federation policy tables are populated with the exact expected counts
SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks pass and a separate connection is used
the SQLite schema and storage policy are unchanged
a killed server restarted in a fresh process resumes round 3 after the round-2 checkpoint
the resumed run ends with the identical final digest and the canonical event stream
the resumed run has one candidate and no duplicated updates or decisions
a RUNNING run without a valid checkpoint or with inconsistent metadata is marked FAILED, never fabricated
recovery leaves finished runs untouched
a REPLAY run replays a real prior completed LIVE_RUN and is visibly run_type REPLAY
a REPLAY performs zero training, submission, aggregation, SecAgg, candidate or governance work
the REPLAY stream has semantic parity with its source
a REPLAY without a completed source fails clearly and creates no run
a REPLAY never uses another user's run or a different configuration
exactly the ten CAP-007 routes exist and no CAP-008/CAP-009 route
system info reports CAPSTONE_PRODUCT_API_V1_2, federation_runtime ENABLED_ENGINEERING, simulated-only hardware and MODEL_V2_FINAL
every federation and model route requires authentication
run create/list/get/start/rounds/WS are owner-only; overview, clients and models are authenticated GLOBAL_READ
WS closes with 4401 / 4403 / 4404 for unauthenticated / foreign / unknown runs
the WebSocket replays from sequence 0 then tails, supports reconnect, zero and multiple subscribers
the federation channel is server-to-client only
at most one LIVE run is active globally and a second start is refused with FEDERATION_RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE
the released default runtime is unchanged and references no candidate
no candidate reference exists in the frontend, the CAP-003 client or the inference service sources
the new modules import no truth, data-loader or scientific-runtime module
no efficacy metric is computed and no inference is run by the new modules
the central database holds only federation metadata, never data, labels or tensors
cross-user access is refused and no monitoring or user data reaches federation
claims stay bounded to engineering and one-laptop logical isolation
no held-out data is loaded
no FL_NEW_LOCAL_BATCH, multi-run history, personalised model or hardware code exists
the targeted CAP-007 tests pass
the CAP-001..006 capstone tests pass
the full local regression passes
frontend npm test passes
svelte-check passes
the frontend build passes
ruff passes
pip check passes
CI was neither queried nor triggered
all twelve mutation controls were caught by a test and restored
the final protected-artifact audit shows no drift and new files only in explicit CAP-007 namespaces
no state file, checkpoint, tensor, SQLite database or runtime event journal was committed
the CAP-007 components are registered and locked
CAP-007 is PASS in the task registry (final)
CAPG6 is PASS in the gate registry (final)
CAP-008 is NOT_STARTED and no CAP-008 artifact exists
all preserved disclosures are carried forward
the final handoff uses the exact required section list
